reported_context.session_intent: Complete the coach-authored 3x8-minute indoor Suito tempo/torque session while outdoor haze prevented riding.
reported_context.continuation_reason: Athlete continued through repetition three after its reported rep RPE crossed the written ceiling through local-leg strain because he believed completing the exercise was necessary to increase VO2max.
reported_context.rpe_component_interpretation: The reported 5/6/8 values describe each repetition's perceived task difficulty as limited by the hardest system. They are not relabeled as whole-body or cardiorespiratory RPE; on repetition three the athlete separately rated local legs 8, breathing 5 and whole body 5.
reported_context.rpe_scale_guardrail: Athlete report uses a conventional 0-10 scale. Garmin post-activity directWorkoutRpe was 80/100 and directWorkoutFeel was 50/100; preserve the two source scales separately.

air_quality.indoor_controls: Doors and windows closed with air filters operating.
air_quality.guardrail: The indoor value is exposure context, not proof of zero respiratory risk.

later_dashboard_context.athlete_interpretation: Rain temporarily suppressed the haze; a raw current PM2.5 point of 38.0 ug/m3 was considered reasonable for outdoor activity.
later_dashboard_context.visual_pattern: PM2.5 fell sharply during the rain, reached a short trough near the high-30s to 40s, then rebounded before the end of the displayed window.
later_dashboard_context.provenance_guardrail: The displayed average and qualitative trajectory are athlete-provided contextual evidence. Exact underlying samples were not supplied, so the stack must not reconstruct a regulatory AQI or an exact rolling series from the image.

session_contract_review.clean_air_controls_and_indoor_pm2_5: Athlete reports outdoor PM2.5 91.2 ug/m3, indoor PM2.5 below 30 ug/m3, doors and windows closed, and air filters operating.
session_contract_review.repetition_average_power_hr_cadence_and_: Garmin repetitions were 169 W / 140 bpm / 70 rpm at reported rep RPE 5, 168 W / 145 bpm / 68 rpm at reported rep RPE 6, and 168 W / 150 bpm / 70 rpm at reported rep RPE 8. On repetition three, local-leg RPE was 8 while breathing and whole-body RPE were each 5; therefore the rep score is not treated as global cardiorespiratory strain.
session_contract_review.power_spread_posture_and_form: Work-repetition average power was mechanically stable at 169/168/168 W. Athlete reported no fit discomfort; posture and form were not otherwise rated.
session_contract_review.technical_quality_notes: Indoor seated tempo/torque execution. Repetitions one and two remained within the intended rep-RPE ceiling. Repetition three crossed the ceiling through local-leg strain rather than breathing or whole-body strain.
session_contract_review.coach_contract_mapping: Repetitions one and two remained within the RPE 5-6 contract. Repetition three reached reported rep RPE 8 through local-leg strain while breathing and whole-body RPE were 5; the athlete continued to its completion and explicitly classified the outcome as triggered_but_continued.
session_contract_review.airway_symptom_status_before_during_and_: Occasional slight runny nose was reported. Exact onset and separation into before, during and after were not supplied; the athlete identified repetition three RPE as the only stop trigger.
session_contract_review.fluid_fuel_sodium_and_cooling: Ceiling fan on maximum; 700 ml water; no during-session carbohydrate because a meal was eaten approximately two hours before; sodium intake not reported.

objective_interval_evidence.source: Garmin activity 24105394715 standard activity, split and FIT surfaces
objective_interval_evidence.power_zone_context: Approximately 21.2 minutes in Garmin power zone 3, 27 seconds in zone 4 and 4 seconds in zone 5; this was not a conventional VO2max interval dose.
objective_interval_evidence.interpretation: External work matched the written power dose closely, while HR rose progressively at near-identical power. Repetitions one and two remained controlled at reported rep RPE 5 and 6. Repetition three reached reported rep RPE 8 through local-leg strain while breathing and whole-body effort remained 5, supporting a torque-durability limiter rather than VO2 physiology.

coach_contract_audit.written_action: Three seated eight-minute repetitions at 165-170 W, 70-75 rpm and RPE 5-6 with four-minute recoveries; end the structured set if repetition two already exceeded RPE 6.
coach_contract_audit.executed_action: Three complete eight-minute repetitions at 169/168/168 W and 70/68/70 rpm with complete recoveries. Reported rep RPE progressed 5/6/8; repetition three reached local-leg RPE 8 while breathing and whole-body RPE remained 5, and the athlete continued through the triggered stop rule.
coach_contract_audit.load_alignment: Garmin load 75.0 matched the written expected range of 40-90.
coach_contract_audit.calibration_disposition: Nominal contract validation is rejected because the explicit stop outcome was triggered_but_continued. The session is not discarded: it is immediately usable for local-leg execution-boundary and safety-adherence learning, while delivered-action physiological response learning remains pending fresh next-day evidence.
coach_contract_audit.next_constraint: No VO2, threshold, Twin Peaks or other meaningful-cost session on 2026-08-26. Use rest or genuinely easy continuity only, then reassess absorption before the protected Friday Enduro exposure.
